rationale: CAPEC and ATT&CK-technique portions are fully correct: the narrative names all 8 gold CAPEC ids (CAPEC-60, 94, 509, 555, 561, 644, 645, 652), correctly ties them to CWE-294, and names all 11 gold must_correlate/attack.must_include_ids technique IDs (T1021, T1021.002, T1114.002, T1133, T1134.001, T1550.002, T1550.003, T1550.004, T1557, T1558, T1558.003) — matching deterministic_scores' correlation (precision/recall/f1=1.0) and mapping_recall (11/11). However the question also asks "what mitigations apply," and gold's attack.must_include_related lists 19 distinct mitigation IDs actually present across the technique records (M1015, M1017, M1018, M1021, M1026, M1027, M1030, M1031, M1032, M1035, M1037, M1041, M1042, M1043, M1047, M1051, M1052, M1054, M1060). The narrative names only 10 of these (M1015, M1018, M1026, M1027, M1030, M1032, M1035, M1041, M1042, M1054), silently dropping 9 that are in the evidence: M1017 (User Training, under T1557), M1021 (Restrict Web-Based Content, under T1133), M1031 (Network Intrusion Prevention, under T1557), M1037 (Filter Network Traffic, under T1557/T1021.002), M1043 (Credential Access Protection, under T1558), M1047 (Audit, under T1558/T1021), M1051 (Update Software, under T1550.002), M1052 (User Account Control, under T1550.002), and M1060 (Out-of-Band Communications Channel, under T1114.002). Every mitigation the narrative does mention is correctly named and traceable to a specific technique record, so there is no fabrication (faithfulness/groundedness = 1.0), but roughly half of the required mitigation coverage is missing, which materially undercuts the answer to the "what mitigations apply" part of the question — hence PARTIAL rather than CORRECT.
